evidence_excerpts: For the largest circuit with 53 qubits and 20 cycles, we collected N_s = 30 × 10^6 samples over ten circuit instances, obtaining F_XEB = (2.24 ±0.21) × 10^-3 for the elided circuits. With 5σ confidence, we assert that the average fidelity of running these circuits on the quantum processor is greater than at least 0.1%.
text: The largest elided 53-qubit, 20-cycle circuits yielded F_XEB = (2.24 ± 0.21) × 10^-3 over 30 million samples, supporting an average fidelity above 0.1% with 5σ confidence.
